name: touchgrass
description: Tells your touchgrass Telegram bot when Claude Code starts and stops thinking, so it can nudge you to move, drink water and take a break while you wait.

bot_url.title: Bot URL
bot_url.description: Your touchgrass bot's address, e.g. https://touchgrass.you.workers.dev. Send /hook to your bot to get it.

hook_key.title: Hook key
hook_key.description: The key your bot shows when you send /hook. Kept in your system's secure storage.
